Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Companion Desktop Launch Practice Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive desktop pet launch practice sub-flow on the finish screen where users can test moving, hiding, and interacting with their companion before landing on the desktop. (why: Support emails show 3 users reporting pets failing to display on desktop and 3 users unclear on controls. Finish step has an 80.1% completion rate with room to improve initial usability.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Existing Pet Recovery Security Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging into an existing account instantly recovers previously created pets and desktop settings. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in. Sign-in hints have historically won 5 out of 10 tests.)
2: [home, wait_info] Companion Hatching Live Countdown Wait Indicator: Adds an estimated completion timer and visual progress indicator to the waiting screen while the desktop pet is rendering in the background. (why: The home waiting step has long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s). Past tests show home wait_info changes succeeded in 4 out of 6 tests.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Save State Persistence Hint: Shows a reassuring hint during path selection stating that path choices are safe and can be changed or expanded anytime later. (why: Choose_path step shows high average duration (mean 514s), suggesting users hesitate when choosing a companion path.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Hatch Completion Desktop Notification Switch: Adds an explicit system notification toggle to the waiting screen so users can be notified immediately when background rendering finishes. (why: The waiting step takes a long time (mean 2336s). Giving users a system notification option prevents abandonments during background rendering.)
5: [finish, hint] Companion Hide & Show Quick Shortcut Hint: Displays a key shortcut tip on the finish screen showing how to toggle the pet on and off the desktop keyboard controls. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion over how to hide or summon the desktop companion once setup completes.)
